title: ACEMAGIC K1 Mini PC AMD Ryzen 4300U, 16GB DDR4, 256GB SSD, WiFi 5, Triple 4K Display
writeup: The ACEMAGIC K1 is a 128 mm square Windows 11 Pro mini PC for browser-and-spreadsheet work, video calls and a multi-monitor home desk. ACEMAGIC lists a 4-core Ryzen 3 4300U, 16GB of DDR4 in two SO-DIMM slots, two M.2 slots, and HDMI, DisplayPort and USB-C outputs rated for three 4K 60Hz screens. MiniPCDeals, citing Notebookcheck data, puts its multi-core Cinebench R23 score near 3,571 versus about 2,490 for an Intel N150. It is $229 new. The drawbacks: it is a 2020 chip with only 4 threads, no hardware AV1 decoding, and Gigabit Ethernet and Wi-Fi 5.
